body: It may be desirable to draw attention to a difficulty in the engine's ordered operations, for the spec commands the machinery to perform a test whose gears cannot engage. FR-006 mandates a Wilcoxon signed-rank test across but five random seeds; with n=5 paired observations, the smallest attainable two-sided p-value is approximately 0.0625, so no comparison in the family — however genuine its underlying effect — can ever survive the declared FDR < 0.05 threshold. The success criterion SC-003 is thus arithmetically unreachable as specified, and the whole edifice of Benjamini-Hochberg correction over seven hypotheses rests upon a foundation that cannot yield a single significant result. A second, quieter inconsistency: User Story 1's acceptance scenario 2 orders the system to 'raise a clear error' when memory is exceeded, whereas FR-002 orders subsampling 'by retaining the largest connected component' — two contradictory dispositions for the same contingency; and, moreover, retaining only the largest connected component may silently excise precisely those sparsely-connected botnet nodes whose anomalous character the project seeks to detect, biasing the labels rather than preserving them. Finally, FR-005 speaks of 'held-out test scenarios' (a between-scenario split) while FR-008 ordains a temporal holdout within windows — two distinct evaluation geometries left unreconciled, with the split fractions deferred; the engine can execute either, but the spec does not yet tell us which pattern it is to weave.
